findings.title: Login predicate NPEs when IDP config is null
findings.body: In IdentityProviderStorageProvider.java line 254 getLoginPredicate() does idp.getOrganizationId() == null || Boolean.parseBoolean(idp.getConfig().get(...)). If an IdentityProviderModel has a null config map and a non-null organizationId, idp.getConfig().get() throws NullPointerException. The predicate is now called on create/remove/update paths in InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider to decide login-cache invalidation, so a null-config org-linked IDP breaks those writes instead of just skipping invalidation. Use a null-safe access such as getConfig() == null check or getOrDefault.

findings.title: remove() NPEs when alias does not exist
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java remove() unconditionally does storedIdp = idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias) then registerIDPInvalidation(storedIdp) when the alias key is invalidated. registerIDPInvalidation dereferences idp.getInternalId() and idp.getAlias(). If no IDP exists for the alias, storedIdp is null and the remove of a non-existent alias throws NullPointerException instead of returning false. The old code had the same pattern but the new code also passes storedIdp to registerIDPLoginInvalidation, widening the path. Guard for null before invalidating.

findings.title: update() NPEs when IDP id is unknown
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java update() does IdentityProviderModel idpById = getById(model.getInternalId()) then registerIDPInvalidation(idpById) and registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate(idpById, model) without a null check. getById returns null when the internalId does not exist. registerIDPInvalidation immediately calls idp.getInternalId(), so updating a non-existent or already-removed IDP throws NullPointerException instead of delegating to storage. Add a null guard.

findings.title: removeAll() does not invalidate login caches
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java removeAll() only calls registerCountInvalidation() and explicitly skips per-entry invalidation. The new getForLogin() cache keyed by cacheKeyForLogin(realm, mode) is therefore left populated after all IDPs are deleted, so subsequent getForLogin() calls can return stale IDs until natural eviction or until the fallback getById miss path fires. The method must also register invalidation for each FetchMode login key.

findings.title: Login cache not invalidated by organization-side changes
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java getForLogin() caches IDP id sets per realm+FetchMode+organizationId, but invalidation is only registered from IdentityProviderStorageProvider.create/update/remove. Organization-side mutations that change the same result set - linking/unlinking an IDP to an org, removing an org, disabling/enabling an org, toggling org membership visibility - go through OrganizationProvider and never invalidate cacheKeyForLogin. The cached id list is then resolved via getById and returned, showing IDPs from the wrong org or showing IDPs whose org was removed/disabled as still available for login.
